commit.message:
Add support for routing minio requests from the Mender API gateway

This commit introduces new settings:

- global.url: the public URL where the Mender server is exposed
- api_gateway.minio: settings to enable and configure routing of minio
  requests; defaults are using a k8s service named `minio`

Changelog: title

Signed-off-by: Fabio Tranchitella <fabio.tranchitella@northern.tech>

commit.message:
Pass non-SSL env variable to api-gateway

If SSL termination is handled outdide of the api-gateway pod, this
state shuold be signaled using the `SSL` flag. Since the api-gateway
container already implements this infrastructure requirement and
handles the SSL environment variable, it is just a matter of
passing the SSL variable from the helm values to the container.

Signed-off-by: Alexandru Ionita <alexandru.ionita@gmail.com>
